info.title: Financial Import API
info.description:
REST API of the Financial Import system.

**Authentication.** Call `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with the demo account
(`demo@example.com` / `password`) and send the returned token as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens expire after 8 hours.

**Money.** All amounts are integer **cents** (`115346` = R$ 1.153,46). A transaction's
amount is always positive; `type` (`income` or `expense`) says whether it adds or subtracts.

**Imports.** `POST /api/v1/imports` answers `202` at once and the file is processed in the
background. Poll `GET /api/v1/imports/{id}` until `is_finished` is `true`.
Uploading the same file twice answers `409` with the existing `import_id`.
